newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Values mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Values mostly lower.

text.p: Millfeed prices were mostly lower again Wednesday, but some buyer interest surfaced early in reaction to higher CBOT corn futures, dealers said.
Forecasts for a crop-damaging freeze late this week in the Midwest prompted buying of CBOT corn early. However, CBOT prices later slid from early highs amid harvest pressure.
When CBOT corn slipped buyers stepped back and sellers appeared to be more aggressive on offers, dealers said.
"It is a buyers market right now," said a Texas dealer, who sold a few spot loads at $95 per ton Wednesday. The price was down $5 from recent offers.

Buffalo sources reported improved buyer interest at lower price levels, but overall demand remained light. Also, ample supplies throughout the Eastern Seaboard has lessened the need to ship product from Buffalo.
Buffalo millfeed was bid $85 and offered $87 per tonne for prompt shipment. The offer was down $5 from Tuesday, and no bid was quoted Tuesday.
